name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income support of ₹6,000/year to small and marginal farmers in three equal instalments.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year directly to bank account in 3 instalments of ₹2,000 each.
how_to_apply: Apply at local Common Service Centre (CSC) or pmkisan.gov.in

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY
description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing ₹5 lakh health cover per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalisation.
benefits: ₹5 lakh health insurance cover per year. Covers 1,929 medical procedures.
how_to_apply: Visit nearest empanelled hospital or check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in

name: PM Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Provides financial assistance to rural households to construct pucca houses with basic amenities.
benefits: ₹1.20 lakh (plain areas) or ₹1.30 lakh (hilly/NE/difficult areas) for house construction.
how_to_apply: Apply through Gram Panchayat or pmayg.nic.in

name: PM Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Housing for All urban mission providing subsidy on home loans for EWS/LIG/MIG categories.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Interest subsidy of up to 6.5% on home loans. Credit linked subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh.
how_to_apply: Apply through banks, housing finance companies, or pmaymis.gov.in

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Small savings scheme for the girl child offering attractive interest rates and tax benefits.
benefits: 8.2% interest rate (2024), tax exemption under Section 80C. Matures when girl turns 21.
how_to_apply: Open account at any post office or authorised bank with birth certificate of girl child.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
description: Scheme to address declining child sex ratio and promote welfare of the girl child through education.
benefits: Scholarships, awareness campaigns, education support for girl child.
how_to_apply: Contact local Anganwadi or district administration.

name: PM Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Provides loans up to ₹10 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
benefits: Shishu: up to ₹50K | Kishor: ₹50K–5L | Tarun: ₹5L–10L. No collateral required.
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank, MFI, or mudra.org.in

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss due to unforeseen calamities.
benefits: Insurance cover for crop loss. Premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial crops.
how_to_apply: Apply through bank, CSC or pmfby.gov.in before crop season.

name: PM Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: Financial inclusion program ensuring access to financial services like banking, insurance, and pension.
benefits: Zero balance account, RuPay debit card, ₹2 lakh accident insurance, ₹30K life cover, overdraft up to ₹10K.
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch with Aadhaar and photo ID.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Government-backed pension scheme for unorganised sector workers guaranteeing pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000/month.
benefits: Guaranteed pension of ₹1K–₹5K/month after age 60. Spouse gets same pension after subscriber's death.
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank or post office with savings account.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Provides free LPG connections to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
benefits: Free LPG connection with first refill and hotplate. Reduces health hazards from wood/coal cooking.
how_to_apply: Apply at nearest LPG distributor or pmuy.gov.in

name: Stand Up India
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs.
benefits: Loans from ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for greenfield enterprises. 7-year repayment period.
how_to_apply: Apply at standupmitra.in or at any bank branch.

name: PM Scholarship Scheme (PMSS)
description: Scholarship for wards of ex-servicemen and ex-coast guard personnel for professional degree courses.
benefits: ₹3,000/month for boys, ₹3,500/month for girls for professional courses.
how_to_apply: Apply at ksb.gov.in

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity benefit program providing cash incentives to pregnant and lactating women.
benefits: ₹5,000 in instalments for first live birth. Nutritional support during pregnancy.
how_to_apply: Register at nearest Anganwadi centre or health facility.

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor Loan)
description: Micro-credit facility for street vendors to resume livelihoods affected by COVID-19.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefits: Working capital loan: ₹10K (1st), ₹20K (2nd), ₹50K (3rd). Interest subsidy of 7%.
how_to_apply: Apply at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through urban local body.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: Support scheme for artisans and craftspeople (Vishwakarmas) with skill training, loans and market access.
benefits: ₹15K toolkit incentive, skill training stipend ₹500/day, collateral-free loan up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest.
how_to_apply: Register at pmvishwakarma.gov.in via CSC.

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) - Post Matric SC
description: Post-matric scholarship for SC students to support higher education.
benefits: Full tuition fee + maintenance allowance. Covers courses from Class 11 to PhD.
how_to_apply: Apply at scholarships.gov.in

name: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) - Post Matric ST
description: Post-matric scholarship for ST students pursuing higher education.
benefits: Tuition fee reimbursement + maintenance allowance for ST students.
how_to_apply: Apply at scholarships.gov.in

name: NSP - OBC Pre-Matric Scholarship
description: Pre-matric scholarship for OBC students to encourage school education.
benefits: ₹1,000–₹3,500/year scholarship for OBC students in Class 1–10.
how_to_apply: Apply at scholarships.gov.in

name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
description: Skill development scheme to enable youth to take up industry-relevant training and get certified.
benefits: Free skill training with certification. Average training duration: 3 months. Placement assistance.
how_to_apply: Register at pmkvyofficial.org or nearest PMKVY training centre.

name: PMEGP (PM Employment Generation Programme)
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme for setting up new micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
benefits: 25–35% subsidy on project cost up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) / ₹20 lakh (service).
how_to_apply: Apply at kviconline.gov.in

name: Startup India Seed Fund
description: Financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development and market entry.
benefits: Up to ₹20 lakh for proof of concept; up to ₹50 lakh for market entry/commercialisation.
how_to_apply: Apply at startupindia.gov.in

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Life insurance scheme offering ₹2 lakh cover at just ₹436/year.
benefits: ₹2 lakh death benefit. Annual premium of only ₹436.
how_to_apply: Enroll through bank account linked to Aadhaar.

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Accident insurance scheme with ₹2 lakh cover at just ₹20/year.
benefits: ₹2 lakh accidental death/total disability cover. ₹1 lakh for partial disability. Only ₹20/year.
how_to_apply: Enroll through bank or post office savings account.

name: Agnipath Scheme (Agniveer)
description: Short-term military service scheme for youth to serve in Indian Armed Forces for 4 years.
benefits: ₹30K–₹40K/month salary, ₹11.71 lakh Seva Nidhi package on exit, reservations in government jobs after service.
how_to_apply: Apply at joinindianarmy.nic.in / joinindiannavy.gov.in / careerindianairforce.cdac.in

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
description: Promotes apprenticeship training by sharing 25% of stipend cost with employers.
benefits: Stipend support, hands-on industry training, certificate recognised by NCVT.
how_to_apply: Register at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Provides farmers with timely and adequate credit for agricultural needs at subsidised interest rates.
benefits: Credit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest rate after interest subvention. Includes crop insurance.
how_to_apply: Apply at any bank or cooperative bank. Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides farmers with soil health cards showing nutrient status of soil and recommendations.
benefits: Free soil testing, personalised fertiliser recommendations to reduce costs and increase yield.
how_to_apply: Contact local Agriculture Department or soilhealth.dac.gov.in

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
description: Skill and placement programme for rural youth to enable sustainable employment.
benefits: Free residential skill training, 100% placement assistance, post-placement support.
how_to_apply: Apply at ddugky.gov.in or district Rural Development office.

name: MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi NREGA)
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households whose adult members do unskilled manual work.
benefits: 100 days guaranteed employment per year. Current wages: ₹220–₹357/day depending on state.
how_to_apply: Register at Gram Panchayat with household details.

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (PMGKAY)
description: Free food grain scheme providing 5 kg of rice/wheat per person per month to 80 crore beneficiaries.
benefits: 5 kg free food grain per month per person under NFSA.
how_to_apply: Automatic for NFSA ration card holders. Apply for ration card at state FCS department.

name: Scholarships for Top Class Education - SC
description: Full scholarship for SC students admitted to top institutions like IITs, IIMs, NLUs, NITs.
benefits: Full tuition fee + ₹2,220/month maintenance allowance. Covers 266 premier institutions.
how_to_apply: Apply at scholarships.gov.in

name: Rajiv Gandhi National Fellowship (RGNF) - SC/ST
description: Fellowship for SC/ST students to pursue MPhil and PhD in Indian universities.
benefits: ₹31,000/month (JRF) → ₹35,000/month (SRF). HRA and contingency allowance extra.
how_to_apply: Apply at ugc.ac.in during notification period.

name: Maulana Azad National Fellowship (MANF)
description: Fellowship for minority community students to pursue higher education (MPhil/PhD).
benefits: ₹31,000–₹35,000/month fellowship + HRA + contingency.
how_to_apply: Apply at manf.ucanapply.com

name: PM Jan Arogya Yojana (State Variant)
description: State-level health insurance schemes for residents not covered by PM-JAY.
benefits: Health insurance cover ranging ₹2–10 lakh depending on state scheme.
how_to_apply: Apply at state health department or Common Service Centre.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship (Girls - Technical Education)
description: Scholarship for girl students pursuing technical education (degree/diploma) to bridge gender gap.
benefits: ₹50,000/year for tuition + ₹30,000/year for incidentals. Max 4 years.
how_to_apply: Apply at scholarships.gov.in

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship (Differently Abled)
description: Scholarship for differently-abled students pursuing technical education.
benefits: ₹50,000/year tuition + ₹30,000/year incidentals for up to 4 years.
how_to_apply: Apply at scholarships.gov.in

name: Central Sector Scholarship for College Students
description: Merit-based scholarship for students from economically weaker sections who cleared Class 12.
benefits: ₹12,000/year for first 3 years of UG, ₹20,000/year for PG. ₹20,000/year for professional courses.
how_to_apply: Apply at scholarships.gov.in

name: Swachh Bharat Mission - Toilet Construction
description: Financial assistance for construction of individual household toilets in rural areas.
benefits: ₹12,000 incentive for construction of household toilet.
how_to_apply: Apply at Gram Panchayat or swachhbharatmission.gov.in

name: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
description: Provides rooftop solar panels to households and 300 units free electricity per month.
benefits: Up to 78% subsidy on solar installation. 300 units free electricity/month. Save ₹15,000–18,000/year.
how_to_apply: Apply at pmsuryaghar.gov.in

name: Har Ghar Jal - Jal Jeevan Mission
description: Provides piped potable drinking water supply to every rural household by 2024.
benefits: Piped water connection to home. 55 litres per person per day.
how_to_apply: Contact Gram Panchayat or jaljeevanmission.gov.in

name: PM Wani (Wi-Fi Access Network Interface)
description: Provides public Wi-Fi hotspots across India, especially in rural areas through local shops.
benefits: Affordable public Wi-Fi access. Local entrepreneurs can set up hotspots and earn income.
how_to_apply: Contact DoT or nearby Public Data Office.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
description: Scholarship to meritorious students of economically weaker sections to reduce dropout at Class 8.
benefits: ₹12,000/year (₹1,000/month) from Class 9 to 12.
how_to_apply: Apply through state examination board. Exam held in November.

name: PM Drone Didi Yojana
description: Provides drones to Self-Help Groups (SHGs) of women for agricultural services.
benefits: Drones provided to SHGs for rental services. Income of ₹1 lakh/year per SHG.
how_to_apply: Apply through SHG federation or local agriculture department.

name: DigiLocker
description: Cloud-based platform for storage and sharing of documents/certificates in digital format.
benefits: Free 1 GB secure cloud storage. Store Aadhaar, PAN, marksheets, driving licence digitally. Legally valid.
how_to_apply: Register at digilocker.gov.in or DigiLocker app.

name: One Nation One Ration Card
description: Allows migrant workers to access their PDS ration from any Fair Price Shop across India.
benefits: Access subsidised food grains from any FPS across India using existing ration card.
how_to_apply: Existing ration card holders automatically eligible. Link Aadhaar to ration card.

name: UPI Lite & Rupay Credit on UPI
description: Digital payment infrastructure for small transactions without internet connectivity.
benefits: Fast digital payments, cashback offers, zero MDR for merchants.
how_to_apply: Available on any UPI app like BHIM, PhonePe, Google Pay.

name: PM Internship Scheme
description: One-year internship opportunity with top 500 Indian companies for youth aged 21–24.
benefits: ₹5,000/month stipend (₹4,500 from govt + ₹500 from company). ₹6,000 one-time grant. Certificate.
how_to_apply: Apply at pminternship.mca.gov.in

name: Mahila Shakti Kendra
description: Empowers rural women through community engagement and convergence of government schemes.
benefits: Skill development, digital literacy, legal awareness, health & nutrition support for rural women.
how_to_apply: Contact nearest Anganwadi or district Women & Child Development office.

name: SMILE (Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise)
description: Comprehensive welfare scheme for transgender persons and persons engaged in begging.
benefits: Shelter, medical facilities, counselling, education, skill development, economic linkages.
how_to_apply: Contact district Social Welfare office or transgenderindia.nic.in
